Coverage: magnetic effect of current and magnetism (Physics 2nd Paper Ch4, records 301-357) split across the field of a current, forces on currents and moving charges, and magnetic properties of materials including the earth's field; then electromagnetic induction and alternating current (Ch5, records 358-450) split across Faraday's law, inductance, AC circuits and transformers. All descriptions are plain text with no backslashes.
